g.text: Site-Keyed Carrier ac:ρ/ℓ/op — Disjoint Carriers Under Locate-All (subject: Node(PPar{A|B}, PPar{C|D}))
one spread at root nonce ρ (spread_term_par)
ac_carrier_channel embeds the ν-free location path ⌜(ρ,ℓ)⌝, so
ac:ρ/Node.0/PPar ≠ ac:ρ/Node.1/PPar even though the op (PPar) is shared.
REFUTED design — a bare ac:PPar channel (no site key)
both bags' sends land on ONE channel: @\"ac:PPar\"!(⟦A⟧) │ (⟦B⟧) │ (⟦C⟧) │ (⟦D⟧)
the native matcher could pick a CROSS-BAG selection {A, D} ✘ (a latent soundness bug)
The site key is the load-bearing Red-team #5 fix:
it makes each receiver read only its OWN bag's soup.
